R/W Multiple Variables

Owning Palette: Variable Manager

VIs to read and write multiple variables.

 

Palette Object Description
VM3 - Read Variables (ANY).vi Reads multiple variables of arbitrary data types; both predefined and user-defined data types are supported. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - Read Variables (DBL).vi Reads multiple variables of the DBL Number data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - Read Variables (STR).vi Reads multiple variables of the String data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - Write Variables (ANY).vi Writes to multiple variables of arbitrary data types; both predefined and user-defined data types are supported. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - Write Variables (DBL).vi Writes to multiple variables of the DBL Number data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
VM3 - Write Variables (STR).vi Writes to multiple variables of the String data type. Refer to the VI Help for more details.
